name: B2BRouter

provenance.sourceText: Verified directly on the vendor's own site, 2026-09-23: app.b2brouter.net/en/register, developer.b2brouter.net/docs/ -- a real, operating e-invoicing/Peppol platform, plain signup, no invite code.

notes: Owner review of PR #528: two offerings -- Peppol network capability is sourced from the vendor's own site; whether it is ALSO a registered French PA remains unverified, exactly the split the owner asked this catalogue to be able to express (verified on one channel, unverified on another, same entity). No transports/transport-registry.ts id exists for this operator on EITHER offering -- not yet integrated, only researched as a free-to-develop candidate. Home country not independently confirmed in this pass -- both offerings are recorded against 'FR' only because that is the context (French PA candidate research) this platform was actually found in, not a claim about where the vendor itself is based.

sandbox.notes: Plain signup at app.b2brouter.net/en/register (e-mail + password, no invite code), free 'Basic' plan, no card. Docs: developer.b2brouter.net/docs/.

provenance.sourceText: Verified directly on the vendor's own site, 2026-09-23: developer.b2brouter.net/docs/ describes the platform as 'REST + Peppol network'.

offerings.notes: capabilities are all false because no transport exists yet -- the Peppol-network CAPABILITY is sourced, but nothing in this codebase has integrated it.

sandbox.notes: Same app.b2brouter.net/en/register signup as the peppol offering -- one account.

provenance.resolutionNote: Researched 2026-09-23 as a free-sandbox candidate for the French accredited-platform role, but this session never independently confirmed against the DGFiP's own registered-platform list (impots.gouv.fr/je-consulte-la-liste-des-plateformes-agreees) that B2BRouter itself is a registered 'plateforme agreee', nor built or ran any code against it. Settling this needs either a direct check of the DGFiP XLSX export for this name, or building the integration and observing what it actually deposits.
